lines.text: This is Language Explorer, a Star Learner game for reading and writing in English and Spanish. Three big picture tiles lead the way — Read, Write, and Voice — and every step is spoken out loud.
The Read tile opens story covers. Tap a cover to hear the book title, then tap again to open. Inside, words glow gold as they are spoken.
Tap a word to hear it. Double-tap to spell it letter by letter. Press and hold for a kid-friendly meaning when we know one.
The Write tile practices letters with pictures. Pick a picture, hear the letters, then tap alphabet tiles. The right letter glows gold after a few tries.
The Voice tile lets her say an idea out loud. We write it letter by letter while she keeps her pencil on paper — say next to move along.
Language Explorer. Words she can hear, tap, spell, and write. Ready to play on the Star Learner console.
